markdown.markdown: This is a Tutorial for using Quarto in a creating context. * If you never saw a Quarto page before click [here!](beg/Qmd Files/Example Page/index_beg.html) * If you want to *learn* how to create something with Quarto click [here!](int/Qmd Files/Getting Started/getting_started.html) * If you already know how to create Quarto Documents and want to become better click [here!](exp/Qmd Files/Tipps and Tricks/index_exp.html) ```{python} #| echo: false import base64, io, os, tempfile import numpy as np import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import matplotlib.animation as animation from IPython.display import HTML, display fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 3.5), facecolor="#f8f9fa") ax.set_facecolor("#f8f9fa") for spine in ["top", "right", "left"]: ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False) ax.spines["bottom"].set_position("zero") ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#adb5bd") ax.set_xlim(0, 4 * np.pi) ax.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5) ax.set_xticks([]) ax.set_yticks([-1, 0, 1]) ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#adb5bd", labelsize=9) ax.yaxis.set_tick_params(length=0) x = np.linspace(0, 4 * np.pi, 600) levels = [ ("#0d6efd", "Beginner", 0), ("#198754", "Intermediate", np.pi / 3), ("#6f42c1", "Expert", 2 * np.pi / 3), ] lines = [] for color, label, _ in levels: line, = ax.plot([], [], lw=2.5, color=color, label=label, alpha=0.9) lines.append(line) ax.legend(loc="lower center", ncol=3, framealpha=0, fontsize=11, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.05)) n = 60 def init(): for line in lines: line.set_data([], []) return lines def animate(i): shift = i * (2 * np.pi / n) for line, (_, _, offset) in zip(lines, levels): line.set_data(x, np.sin(x - shift + offset)) return lines ani = animation.FuncAnimation(fig, animate, init_func=init, frames=n, interval=50, blit=True) tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".gif", delete=False) tmp.close() ani.save(tmp.name, writer="pillow", fps=20, dpi=100) with open(tmp.name, "rb") as f: b64 = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode() os.unlink(tmp.name) plt.close() display(HTML( f'' )) ```
